parsed.note_claim: The damage was caused by Storm Boelo occurring on the weekend, not due to people's actions.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Met Office has issued an upgraded amber weather warning for strong winds starting from 9pm on Saturday, October 24 until 9pm on Sunday, October 25 as Storm Boelo hits the Capital.
parsed.reason: The page confirms Storm Boelo occurred on the specified weekend with strong winds affecting Edinburgh gardens, directly substantiating the note's claim about the cause.
